# tfctl CLI Overview

The tfctl CLI is a command-line interface tool that enables you to interact with HCP Terraform programmatically. Use tfctl to automate workflows, manage runs, configure variables, and perform API operations directly from your terminal. You can also integrate tfctl with your LLM agents to support AI-assisted workflows.

## Introduction

The tfctl CLI provides a streamlined interface for common HCP Terraform operations. It simplifies authentication, workspace management, and API interactions, allowing you to integrate HCP Terraform into your automation pipelines and development workflows.

## Workflows

The following sections describe the primary workflows for using tfctl.

### Get started

To begin using tfctl, complete the following steps:

1. Install tfctl on your local machine or CI/CD environment.
1. Authenticate with HCP Terraform using your credentials.
1. Configure your profile settings to specify default organizations and workspaces.

Refer to [Install tfctl](/terraform/tfctl-cli/install) and [Authenticate with HCP Terraform](/terraform/tfctl-cli/authenticate) for detailed instructions.

### Integrate with agents

To integrate tfctl with your AI agent, install agent skills with tfctl or NPM. Refer to []() for detailed instructions.

### Manage workspace runs

Use tfctl to start new Terraform workspace runs and check the status of existing runs. Refer to []() for detailed instructions.

### Working with Terraform variables

Use tfclt to manage Terraform variables and variable sets. Refer to []() for detailed instructions.

### Constraints and limitations

- tfctl requires HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise.
- Some commands require specific permissions in your HCP Terraform organization.
- API rate limits apply to tfctl operations.

## Contributing

The tfctl CLI is open source. To contribute to the project or build from source, visit the [tfctl-cli repository on GitHub](https://github.com/hashicorp/tfctl-cli). The repository includes detailed developer documentation, contribution guidelines, and instructions for building from source.
